description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values (AutoNumber reuse and Compact & Repair) on an ACCDB. Three tables AuK, AuC, AuA (ID AutoNumber primary key, S Text) with ten rows each. AuK: rows 8..10 deleted, then an insert, @@IDENTITY read (control, before any compaction). AuC: rows 8..10 deleted, no insert. AuA: all rows deleted, no insert. The database is closed and DBEngine.CompactDatabase writes a work file; then in the compacted file one insert each into AuC and AuA (and AuK), @@IDENTITY read after each. Asks whether Compact & Repair resets the counter to the highest remaining key plus one, which is the competing explanation for the earlier result that deleting the tail did not reuse keys.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
